about: The same call as one mixed file, four voices.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Okay, I think everyone is here. This is the release call for the new theme picker.

truth.speaker: Anna
truth.text: Great. I can start with the beta, if that works for everyone.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Sure, go ahead.

truth.speaker: Anna
truth.text: So the beta went out on Monday to about two hundred people. Switching themes now takes under a second, even on the old ThinkPad.

truth.speaker: Ben
truth.text: Yeah.

truth.speaker: Anna
truth.text: The one thing still open is the preview on high resolution screens. The thumbnails look blurry at scale two.

truth.speaker: Ben
truth.text: I looked at that yesterday. We render them at the wrong size. I can fix it today, it's one line in the shell.

truth.speaker: Carla
truth.text: Wait, is that the same bug we had with the wallpapers last month?

truth.speaker: Ben
truth.text: Similar, but not the same code. The wallpaper one was the cache.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: How long do you think the fix takes, Ben?

truth.speaker: Ben
truth.text: Half a day, maybe less. Then Anna can test it tomorrow morning.

truth.speaker: Anna
truth.text: Tomorrow morning works for me.

truth.speaker: Carla
truth.text: Can I add something about the installer? We changed the second screen and the numbers look really good.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Oh nice, tell us.

truth.speaker: Carla
truth.text: Installs finish in forty seconds now, down from ninety. People stop at the disk encryption step much less now that we explain why it matters.

truth.speaker: Anna
truth.text: That is a big jump.

truth.speaker: Carla
truth.text: It is. I want to do the same for the keyboard layout question next week.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Let's do that. Ben, does that change anything on your side?

truth.speaker: Ben
truth.text: No, it's only text and one picture, Carla can do that without me.

truth.speaker: Ben
truth.text: One more thing. The plugin review for the weather widget is still pending. It has been four days now.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Four days is long. Did we hear anything back?

truth.speaker: Ben
truth.text: Nothing yet. I'll ping them this afternoon.

truth.speaker: Anna
truth.text: If it's not merged by Thursday we should ship the theme picker without it.

truth.speaker: You
truth.text: Agreed. So to sum up: Ben fixes the blurry previews today, Anna tests them tomorrow, Carla starts on the keyboard question, and Ben chases the plugin review.

truth.speaker: Carla
truth.text: Sounds good.

truth.speaker: Anna
truth.text: Perfect, thanks everyone.
